thread:
maya: Quick ask — can someone run a parity telemetry sweep for the private/VPC onprem cluster (4-node, model: redwood-small) and share p95 token latency + disk/io stats? I want to validate the warmup and KV cache behavior after yesterday's kernel bump.
ashwin: I can do it in ~30m. Which branch/flags? Are we validating kernel-5.19 vs 6.1?
maya: kernel-6.1 on prod-like image, with the runtime build from main at commit abc123. Please include fio/tcpdump snippet and a flamegraph if you capture perf. Also capture dmesg for any NAPI WARN.
ashwin: copying run steps here: ```export RUN_ENV=private-vpc; ./scripts/run_bench.sh --nodes 4 --model redwood-small --seq 1024 --warmup 200 --iters 1000 --collect=perf,fio``` I'll run with --kvcache on/off and prefix-cache on. I'll post results.
infra-bot: Scheduled job 20240304-ashwin-parity started on nodes [priv-01,priv-02,priv-03,priv-04]. Logs streaming: https://internal.logs/20240304-ashwin-parity
leah: note — we should also compare perf when iperf3 is running on same NIC vs isolated. Last time we saw 12% p95 spike when iperf3 saturated.
zach: if you see tail latency jumps, add this sysctl to test: `net.core.default_qdisc=fq` and retest. Also check IRQ balancing: `cat /proc/irq/*/smp_affinity`
ashwin: first run (kvcache on) p95 token latency: 42ms. kvcache off: 61ms. fio read latency avg: 0.8ms p95: 3.6ms. Attaching small excerpt: ```fio --name=seqread --rw=read --bs=16k --size=10G --numjobs=4 --runtime=60```
maya: nice. Can you also run with `--seq 2048`? Need to see the long-seq behavior.
ashwin: will do. Quick question — do we want quantized model variant too? That adds more CPU kernel time.
maya: Yes, add q4_0 variant as separate run, but mark it in the logs. Use tag `q4`.
ashwin: ok starting q4 run now. ETA 25m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
infra-bot: Job 20240304-ashwin-parity completed. Summary: p95 token latency (kvcache:on, seq=1024): 42ms; (kvcache:on, seq=2048): 65ms; (kvcache:off, seq=2048): 110ms; q4 variant (seq=1024): 48ms. Full artifacts: https://internal.artifacts/20240304-ashwin-parity
leah: thanks — can someone grab `perf top` for the run with seq=2048 kvcache:off? want to check memcpy hotspots.
zach: fwiw, if p95 > 80ms on seq2048 we should flip to burst-mode routing for dedicated pool.
maya: agreed. @ashwin please add `perf record -F 99 -g --` around the run and upload the script.
ashwin: uploaded perf tarball to artifacts and a small flamegraph: https://internal.artifacts/20240304-ashwin-parity/perf-flame.svg. Key stack shows heavy memcpy and `copy_user_generic_unrolled`.
maya: perfect — small action items: 1) eng-runtime to triage memcpy hotspots (zach), 2) infra to test fq qdisc + irq pinning on priv-02 (leah), 3) follow-up bench after kernel-mode tweaks (ashwin). I'll log a short ticket.
zach: ack. I'll start with a micro-benchmark patch to use non-temporal stores in the memcpy path and run in dev farm.
leah: scheduling irq pinning test for tonight 02:00 UTC, will report.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
